import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[...,0],im[...,1],im[...,2]
masks = {
 'red': (R>130)&(R-G>60)&(R-B>60),
 'orange': (R>170)&(G>80)&(G<175)&(B<95)&(R-B>90),
 'yellow': (R>180)&(G>160)&(B<130)&(G-B>70),
}
for name,m in masks.items():
    lab,n = ndimage.label(m)
    sizes = ndimage.sum(np.ones_like(lab),lab,range(1,n+1))
    print('==',name,'components',n)
    for i in np.argsort(-sizes)[:8]:
        idx=i+1
        ys,xs=np.where(lab==idx)
        print(f'  size={int(sizes[i]):4d} bbox x[{xs.min()},{xs.max()}] y[{ys.min()},{ys.max()}] cx={xs.mean():.1f} cy={ys.mean():.1f}')
\""
